name: Crow Wing River (Huntersville–Cottingham)
gaugeName: Crow Wing River at Nimrod, MN

gaugeContext.note: The Nimrod station provides same-river flow context. These trips span upstream and downstream reaches and tributaries; this reading does not establish flow at every landing or a calibrated paddling speed.

blurb: Choose forest paddles near Huntersville, rapids above Nimrod, or shorter outings between Little White Dog, Knob Hill and Cottingham. Public carry-in locations are labelled as approximate areas, with current agency trip mileage and access directions.
